name: shadcn-area
note: The register the corpus adopted: card header and footer, bare axes, horizontal dashed grid, gradient area, chip legend; the interactive area with its range select at the top, twelve variants below.

name: shadcn-bar
note: Bar family: rounded free corners, label inside and above, negative bars, horizontal bars, a mixed bar list with per-row colour.

name: shadcn-line
note: Line family: 2px linear and step lines, dot policies, a custom-label line with the highlighted point, a two-series header with totals.

name: shadcn-tooltip
note: Every tooltip card variant on the same stacked bar: indicator dot, line and dashed, no indicator, no label, custom label and formatter. The card measured in phase 15.

name: shadcn-radial
note: Radial rings with a centred total in several forms; a form the corpus deliberately does not draw, kept as the counter-example.

name: shadcn-pie
note: Pie and donut variants with legends and centre labels; the other form the corpus substitutes with unit grids and rings.

name: tremor-area
note: Tremor area chart: soft gradient fills, a compact legend row, a dark code block beside the live example; the Tailwind sibling of the shadcn register.

name: tremor-tracker
note: The tracker: a row of status cells for uptime or deployments, the smallest chart form on the list and one the corpus lacks.

name: tremor-bar-list
note: The bar list: ranked horizontal bars with the label inside the bar and the value at the right edge; a table and a chart at once.

name: tremor-spark
note: Spark area, line and bar charts at KPI size; the micro-visualisation family worth adding to the corpus.

name: tremor-blocks
note: Composed dashboard blocks: KPI cards with sparklines, chart cards with header controls, in one visual system.

name: mantine-area
note: Recharts wrapped in a full component system: legend below, series toggles, stacked and split variants, a restrained blue and teal pair on a plain grid.

name: mantine-bar
note: Grouped, stacked and waterfall bars with a violet ramp; the legend and tooltip share the library tokens.

name: mantine-line
note: Line charts with gradient strokes, dashed reference lines and per-point dots; the gradient-line idea is distinctive.

name: nivo-line
note: A saturated pastel set on a light grid with the live prop editor beside it; dense multi-line in a playful palette.

name: nivo-bar
note: Stacked and grouped bars in the same pastel set, with pattern fills as a colour alternative.

name: chartjs-line
note: The canvas default: pink and blue lines with markers on a grey grid. The baseline for un-designed defaults.

name: apex-line
note: Twelve line variants in a gallery grid: annotations, dashed, stepline, gradient, missing data, real-time. Useful for annotation placement.

name: echarts-examples
note: The widest catalogue of forms; one colour set across hundreds of examples.

name: d3-gallery
note: The D3 gallery of bespoke forms; the reference for what a standalone SVG can express.

name: plot-gallery
note: Observable Plot examples in one restrained style: dots, lines, bars, areas, facets, maps.

name: plot-area-docs
note: The area mark page in both schemes: monochrome fills on bare axes, stacked and banded variants, the leanest area charts on the list.

name: plot-line-docs
note: The line mark page in both schemes: thin ink lines, gap handling, multi-series with a colour legend.

name: vegalite-examples
note: The Vega-Lite example gallery; declarative charts with sensible default axes and legends.

name: vega-editor-line
note: A single Vega-Lite line beside its spec; the default axis and grid treatment.

name: layerchart
note: Svelte chart set on a landing with a violet accent; the thumbnail wall shows the whole range in one visual system, in both schemes.

name: tanstack-charts
note: The 2026 entrant: composed SVG and canvas charts, funnel, rings and a world map in both schemes.

name: unovis-gallery
note: Line, area, stacked and scatter galleries in one modular system; the area-with-gaps and multi-line examples are close to the corpus forms.

name: visx-gallery
note: Low-level primitives from Airbnb; expressive one-off forms rather than a system.

name: amcharts-demos
note: A demo grid with a violet and blue set; breadth of column and stacked variants.

name: plotly-line
note: The Plotly default; the only major library with keyboard mark navigation by default.

name: carbon-simple
note: IBM Carbon guidance on simple chart types with the resources and the Carbon chart look below.

name: carbon-chart-anatomy
note: Carbon chart anatomy: the annotated diagram of title, axes, legend, gridlines and tooltip with the spacing rules.

name: apple-hig-charts
note: Apple HIG charts page in both schemes: the hero chart and the anatomy section behind Swift Charts.

name: urban-styleguide
note: The Urban Institute style guide with its chart parts, typography and colour sections in view.

name: owid-life-expectancy
note: Our World in Data grapher: direct end labels, entity selector, table and map tabs, a source line and download row, with the explanatory sections below. The best public editorial chart product.

name: owid-co2
note: The same grapher on a dense multi-line series; log toggle and label collision handling.

name: flourish-examples
note: Flourish template gallery on a dark ground; editorial forms with strong typography.

name: vercel-analytics
note: A single hairline line chart as a hero with a small tooltip card, then dashboard panels; the most minimal register on the list.
